verdict.rationale: telli lets users create an API key in Settings > Developer and send it as a bearer token, so an agent can be given programmatic credentials. Nothing in the evidence shows scoping, permission limits, or per-agent keys, which is the core of the story. Missing for 10: scoped or least-privilege permissions on API keys, per-agent or restricted credential issuance, key rotation/revocation controls, independent corroboration.
